senses.gloss: m. (v. נַבְגָּא; whence ἄμβικος, ἄμβιξ, ambiga) a small cup; a measure containing one fourth of a Log.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 58b:3">B. Bath. 58ᵇ</cite> on the gates of … it is written, <he>אנבג אנפק וכ׳</he> (Ms. differ. order) Anbag, Anpak a. Antal (as the same measures).
Kidd. 70ᵃ לישתי מר אנבגא will you take a cup (of wine &c.)? [Popular pronunciation: anpak.] Sabb. 109ᵇ אנפקא; a. e.
